messages:
alex: Cutting RC candidate now - artifact gcr.io/redwood/rc:20260323-7. Staging smoke passed (basic gen + kv warm). planning staged promote at 00:30 UTC. anyone opposed?

maria: quick q - DB migration window still at 01:00 UTC, right? that overlaps with full-promote. we should avoid full traffic before migration is run.

kevin: +1 to staged. suggest 10% -> 50% -> 100% with 10m holds. also pin the previous stable as fallback: gcr.io/redwood/stable:20260315-4

alex: yep migration at 01:00 stays. plan: promote to 10% at 00:30, observe 20m, then hold. if green, move to 50 at 00:55, hold until migration finishes, then 100 post-migration. pining stable as kevin suggested.

deploy-bot: [deploy-bot] artifact verified: gcr.io/redwood/rc:20260323-7 checksum ok. staging smoke results: 12/12 tests pass. kv-warm: success. ETA to promote: 00:30 UTC.

linda: can someone add a one-liner for release notes? ops wants a short summary for the ticket.

alex: release notes blurb: "Improve batching kernel selection for latency-sensitive paths; runtime fixes for KV caching during mid-sequence truncation." keep it short.

sheriff-czar: acked. I'll be on-call for the promo window (00:25-02:00). If any P50 spike >200ms or error rate >0.6% escalate immediately.

kevin: executing pin -> promote sequence. pin command: `./release/pin-artifact --service api --tag gcr.io/redwood/stable:20260315-4`

kevin: promo step 1 -> 10% issued: `/deploy promote --artifact gcr.io/redwood/rc:20260323-7 --traffic 10 --note "rc-lite staged promote"`

deploy-bot: [deploy-bot] Promo 10% started at 00:30:12 UTC. warming routes. observed 120 req/s baseline. no errors in first 5m.

alex: holding for 20m, watch traces & p50/p95. ops please call if anything looks off.

maria: saw a small uptick in retries on embed service at +8m, but within noise. keeping eye.

deploy-bot: [deploy-bot] Promo 50% initiated at 00:55:05 UTC after hold. warming caches.

kevin: holding at 50 until migration completes.

deploy-bot: [deploy-bot] Migration script kickoff at 01:00:03 UTC: `./migrations/run --id 20260323-schema-b`

linda: migration ticket updated: "DB index add for responses.user_id - expected lock time ~30s"

deploy-bot: [deploy-bot] Migration finished at 01:00:40 UTC. duration 37s. no errors.

alex: moving to 100% now. `/deploy promote --artifact gcr.io/redwood/rc:20260323-7 --traffic 100`

deploy-bot: [deploy-bot] Full promo started at 01:01:10 UTC. gradual ramp.

kevin: saw a small bump in p95 at 01:02 but p50 steady. continuing to monitor.

sheriff-czar: saw a brief 0.9% error spike at 01:03 in the embed service, root cause appears to be N+1 in a consumer job, rolling back to stable to be safe.

alex: rollback decision agreed. rollback command: `/deploy rollback --to gcr.io/redwood/stable:20260315-4 --by-tag stable-20260315-4`

deploy-bot: [deploy-bot] Rollback initiated at 01:04:02 UTC. draining new pods, reattaching stable.

deploy-bot: [deploy-bot] Rollback complete at 01:06:18 UTC. traffic back to gcr.io/redwood/stable:20260315-4.

maria: filing postmortem note: small consumer job regression caused embed retries -> error blip. will include repro & fix in follow-up PR.

linda: updating release notes: "RC 20260323-7 promoted then rolled back due to embed service regression; root cause under investigation. Stable re-pinned."

alex: thanks all. closing this thread. we'll retest candidate after fix and iterate on a new rc. :white_check_mark:
